market.question: Will the highest temperature in Sao Paulo be 26°C on April 30?

assessment.reasoning: Sao Paulo Guarulhos April 30 forecast high: 79°F (~26.1°C), partly cloudy. The 26°C bucket is right at the central forecast. With typical ±1-2°C forecast error, 26°C is the modal outcome but neighbouring 25°C and 27°C buckets also have substantial probability.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Cloud cover variability affecting peak temperature by 1-2C
